contexts.text: (Hated) still more those who in any way opposed themselves.
That the teachers who were in evils opposed themselves. Signified, Explained.
That falsity would oppose itself. Signified, Explained.
Opposition. Signified, Explained... For the Divine never opposes itself to anyone; but it is man who opposes himself to the Divine...
Hatred and revenge against those who oppose themselves. HH 587:2. SE 4587.
